about.lead: I'm Cass — 22, and I train out of DJL. This is my corner of the internet: honest, unfinished, and always in progress.
about.paragraph: I'm not here to perform a perfect version of myself. I'd rather show the real thing — the early starts, the reps that don't feel good, the days I show up anyway. Training taught me that progress is quiet and mostly unglamorous. That's the part I've come to love.

Outside of training I'm curious about almost everything: design, music, the small details most people scroll past. I like clean lines, honest work, and people who mean what they say. If that sounds like you, my inbox is always open.

now.intro: A quick snapshot of where I'm at. It changes — that's the point.

principles.intro: Three things I keep coming back to, in training and everywhere else.

principle.title: Show up
principle.text: The simple part, and the hard part. Get there, do the work, let it count.

principle.title: Stay present
principle.text: Notice the day you're actually in. That's where everything happens.

principle.title: Keep going
principle.text: Nothing has to be perfect. It just has to keep moving forward.
